parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the four rotation lids of the box made of cardboard, forming the top flaps that can open or close the box.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a cover to protect the contents of the box and can be folded inward or outward to open or close the box.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the top edge of the box base, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation lid of the box made of cardboard, similar to the other flaps.
parts.Functional_description: It helps in sealing the box when folded inward and provides structural support when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along its hinge line at the top edge of the box base.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the third rotation lid of the box, made of cardboard, forming part of the top closure system.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to closing the box and protecting the contents from dust or damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its fold line, allowing it to open or close with the other lids.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth rotation lid of the box, made of cardboard, completing the set of flaps that close the top.
parts.Functional_description: It helps in fully sealing the box when all lids are folded inward.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge line, moving in coordination with the other lids.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the box made of cardboard, forming the main container structure.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the contents of the box, providing the main volume and structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it serves as the foundation for the rotation lids.
